name: Edmonton River Queen
name_note: Transport Canada: EDMONTON QUEEN (THE), official number 817706, no former name. Operator site: Edmonton Queen and Edmonton Riverboat. Wikipedia: Edmonton Queen 1995-2018, Edmonton Riverboat from 2018. Journal, 6 May 2024: Edmonton Queen Riverboat. Auction sheet, 2016: Edmonton River Queen. One hull. No R code. This is not a bridge.
centre_note: Mean of the five corners of way 67563569, the pier named Rafter's Landing (Edmonton Riverboat), the repeated closing node dropped. The unrounded mean is 53.53953416, -113.4818826. It is a mapped point. It is not a surveyed dock. The mapped vessel polygon has its own centroid, stored on way 1373511013. Wikipedia returned no coordinate for the article on 14 October 2026. None was stored.
plan_length_note: plan_length_m is the horizontal length of that way's nodes in order, WGS84 haversine with radius 6378137 m, rounded to one decimal. On a closed way it is the perimeter, not a hull length and not a dock length. No elevations are stored.
dropped_note: Ways 512178341 and 709618187 are dirt paths named Edmonton Queen, 331.5 m and 223.1 m. They are trails on the south bank. They are not the hull and they are not the pier. They were not copied. No hull outline was drawn for this file.

ways.which: Closed OpenStreetMap pier named Rafter's Landing (Edmonton Riverboat). Five corners. plan_length_m is the perimeter, 29.6 m. Edge lengths in node order are 2.2, 12.5, 1.1, 1.0, and 12.8 m. The long edges are the mapped pier. They are not a published dock length. The mean of the corners is the project centre.

Closed outline named Edmonton Riverboat, tagged as a building and a restaurant, mapper check_date 2026-08-05. This is the mapped vessel. It is not a surveyed hull. plan_length_m is the perimeter, 119.4 m. The longest span between corners is 53.5 m, from 53.5395330, -113.4823342 to 53.5397415, -113.4816061, bearing 64.3 degrees from the southwest end to the northeast end. That span is not the registered length. The centroid below is the mean of the 14 corners. Edge lengths in node order are 33.8, 6.0, 5.9, 4.3, 2.7, 3.4, 7.3, 4.7, 6.7, 21.1, 8.3, 3.5, 8.6, and 3.1 m.
